units.source_text: 二月初十日，天降微雨，庭前红梅盛开，色香美妙无比。

en.t: On the tenth day of the second month, a fine rain fell from the sky, and the red plum blossoms before the garden were in full bloom, lovely beyond compare in color and fragrance.

units.source_text: 此时萤兵部卿亲王来了。

en.t: At that time Prince Hotaru, the Minister of War, arrived.

units.source_text: 他是为了明石小女公子着裳仪式在即，特地前来探望的。

en.t: He had come specially to visit because the robing ceremony for the young lady of Akashi was close at hand.

units.source_text: 这位亲王与源氏自昔交情特厚，二人肝胆相照，无所不谈。

en.t: This prince and Genji had been especially close since long ago; they trusted each other completely and spoke of everything.

units.source_text: 正在共赏红梅，前斋院槿姬派人送信来了，其信系在一枝半已零落的梅花枝上。

en.t: While they were admiring the red plum blossoms together, Princess Asagao, the former Saiin, sent a messenger with a letter, which was tied to a plum branch whose blossoms had already half fallen.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王知道槿姬与源氏往日交情，见了这信颇感兴趣，问道：“看来这信是她自动送来的，为了何事呢？”

en.t: Prince Hotaru knew of the former relationship between Princess Asagao and Genji, and seeing the letter, he was quite intrigued and asked, “It seems she sent this of her own accord; what can it be about?”

units.source_text: 源氏微笑着答道：“我老实不客气地托她调制香剂，她郑重其事地赶紧制成了。”

en.t: Genji replied with a smile, “I asked her quite frankly to blend some incense for me, and she took it very seriously and quickly prepared it.”
Then he put the letter away out of sight.

units.source_text: 随函送来的是一只沉香木箱子，内装两个琉璃缽，一个是藏青色的，一个是白色的，里面都盛着大粒的香丸。

en.t: Accompanying the letter was a box of aloeswood containing two glass bowls, one dark blue and one white, both filled with large incense pellets.

units.source_text: 藏青琉璃缽盖上的装饰是五叶松枝，白琉璃缽盖上的装饰是白梅花枝。

en.t: The ornament on the lid of the dark blue glass bowl was a five-needle pine branch, and the ornament on the lid of the white glass bowl was a branch of white plum blossoms.

units.source_text: 系在两缽上的带子也都非常优美。

en.t: The cords tied around the two bowls were also exceedingly elegant.

units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王赞道：“样子真漂亮！”

en.t: Prince Hotaru praised them, saying, “How beautiful they look!”

units.source_text: 仔细观赏，但见里面附有小诗一首：

en.t: Looking closely, they saw that a short poem had been enclosed inside:
